Necessity. Very useful app! I frankly didn’t keep track of my period and relied on my body giving me hints beforehand. After getting a copper IUD, the heavy periods that came with it made relying on hints a recipe for embarrassment. This app is very useful for at least getting ball park information and even planning vacation. It’s documentation of my cycle has even given me insight into how my mental state changes with my cycle. It’s been an invaluable tool in knowing what me and my body need and how to prepare. It’s an app I believe should be a piece to every menstruator’s health maintenance. For necessity sake, it has served me well, but it has also given great tips on feminine health and well being with its articles that I enjoy! Please take care of yourselves out there and find an app or tool as good as this has been for me.

It’s ok.. All I want to do is track my period/symptoms and guesstimate when my next ovulation/period symptoms will be (irregular cycles). 
I really like the custom field and used it to track the number of clots. 
I really do NOT like the cycle day functionality. If I enter a period flow, the app asks if I’m starting a new period cycle. Yes, automatically overwrites my entry for the day and pre-populates the next few days data. The default data is not derived from my history. No, automatically deletes my entry for the day. I.e. I am forced to always say yes and then remember to write over the default data. There is not another way to adjust the cycle day that I can find either. Example: cycle day 15 I have bleeding heavier than just spotting. The only way to enter it as period flow is to “start a new cycle”, which throws off all other predictive dates.

I also don’t like all the clutter of the locked data categories, but understand it’s your way of trying to make money.
